gaps.sentence: The programme aims at the ___ (EDUCATE) of young farmers.
The report was highly ___ (CRITICISE) of the ministry.
gaps.explanation: 'Be critical of' — adjective; 'criticism' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: He lost his ___ (CONFIDENT) after the failure.
The new software ___ (ABLE) staff to work securely from anywhere.
gaps.explanation: 'Enable somebody to do something' — the present-tense verb fits the singular subject.

gaps.sentence: The factory will ___ (EMPLOY) fifty more workers next year.
gaps.explanation: The bare verb follows 'will': will employ.
'Argument' — note the e is dropped from argue.

gaps.sentence: He suffers from ___ (SLEEP) since the accident.
